The '''Apalis Fields''' was a series of [[Farm/Legends|farm]] fields along the [[Apalis Coast]], just north of the [[Seaside Windfarms]]. The fields were west of the [[Organa Vinerium]], which used the harvest from the Apalis Fields to produce wine for [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces under [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Herkuun]] and [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Jharkus Thul]] invaded the Vinerium and the Apalis Fields.
